inlines.v: B'ALMY, adjective Having the qualities of balm; aromatic. 2. Producing balm; as the balmy tree. 3. Soothing; soft; mild; as balmy slumbers. 4. Fragrant; odoriferous; as balmy wings. 5. Mitigating; easing; assuaging; as balmy breath.
